column1: # LUKS setup uses a per-run keyfile, --batch-mode, --pbkdf pbkdf2, and --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000. These are test-only, not product settings.
# Setup steps are separated by semicolons. A post-mount step is run after mounting.

column2: mkfs.ext4 -F -b 4096 -O encrypt -L data %DEVICE%; post-mount fscryptctl set_policy %FSCRYPT_KEY_ID% %MOUNTPOINT%/encrypted

cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --cipher aes-xts-plain64 --key-size 512 --key-file %KEYFILE% --batch-mode --pbkdf pbkdf2 --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000 %BASE_DEVICE%; cryptsetup open --key-file %KEYFILE% %BASE_DEVICE% fscompare_crypt; mkfs.btrfs -f -L data -m dup -d dup --csum crc32c %DEVICE%

cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --cipher aes-xts-plain64 --key-size 512 --key-file %KEYFILE% --batch-mode --pbkdf pbkdf2 --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000 %BASE_DEVICE%; cryptsetup open --key-file %KEYFILE% %BASE_DEVICE% fscompare_crypt; mkfs.ext4 -F -b 4096 -L data %DEVICE%

cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --cipher xchacha12,aes-adiantum-plain64 --key-size 256 --key-file %KEYFILE% --batch-mode --pbkdf pbkdf2 --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000 %BASE_DEVICE%; cryptsetup open --key-file %KEYFILE% %BASE_DEVICE% fscompare_crypt; mkfs.ext4 -F -b 4096 -L data %DEVICE%

cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --cipher aes-xts-plain64 --integrity hmac-sha256 --key-file %KEYFILE% --batch-mode --pbkdf pbkdf2 --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000 %BASE_DEVICE%; cryptsetup open --key-file %KEYFILE% %BASE_DEVICE% fscompare_crypt; mkfs.ext4 -F -b 4096 -L data %DEVICE%
integritysetup format --batch-mode %BASE_DEVICE%; integritysetup open %BASE_DEVICE% fscompare_integrity; mkfs.ext4 -F -b 4096 -L data %DEVICE%
integritysetup format --batch-mode %BASE_DEVICE%; integritysetup open --integrity-bitmap-mode %BASE_DEVICE% fscompare_integrity; mkfs.ext4 -F -b 4096 -L data %DEVICE%
